hero_tagline: Compute at the Horizon of Certainty
section_why_description: Modern scientific computing demands more than correct arithmetic—it demands epistemic integrity. Most languages treat uncertainty as an afterthought. Sounio makes it foundational.
feature_uncertainty_desc: Every value can carry its uncertainty. The Knowledge<T> type wraps values with uncertainty, confidence, and provenance metadata.
feature_propagation_desc: GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation through all mathematical operations. You write the physics, the compiler handles the statistics.
feature_provenance_desc: Data without origin is data without trust. Every measurement traces back to its source—essential for reproducibility and regulatory compliance.
feature_confidence_desc: When confidence drops below a threshold, execution can pause, warn, or take alternative paths. The system knows what it doesn't know.
feature_domain_desc: Built-in DSLs for PK/PD modeling (MedLang), neuroimaging (fMRI), causal inference, and GPU-accelerated computing.
feature_standards_desc: Designed for GUM, ISO 17025, 21 CFR Part 11, and FAIR principles. Compliance is not optional—it's architectural.
maturity_description: Sounio is in active development. Here's the current maturity of core features to help you understand what's production-ready.
comparison_description: Sounio uniquely combines epistemic computing as a first-class concern with high-performance systems programming.
usecases_description: Sounio excels in domains where uncertainty quantification and provenance matter most.
install_step1_desc: Download the latest Sounio compiler for your platform:
docs_description: Comprehensive guides and references for learning and using Sounio.
docs_language_guide_desc: Comprehensive reference for Sounio syntax and semantics.
docs_stdlib_desc: API documentation for all stdlib modules and functions.
docs_examples_desc: Code examples demonstrating language features and best practices.
newsletter_description: Get the latest news on Sounio development, releases, and research.
research_description: Sounio is built on rigorous academic foundations with peer-reviewed validation and standards compliance.
perf_description: GPU-accelerated hypercomplex algebra delivering 11-16× speedup on neural network operations, validated with 38 mathematical correctness tests.
name_description: Cape Sounion (Σούνιο) stands at the southernmost tip of Attica, where the ancient Temple of Poseidon has watched over the Aegean for 2,500 years. At sunset, its Doric columns catch the last light—the horizon where certainty meets the unknown sea.
name_meaning: Sounio the language embodies this metaphor: computing at the boundary between what we know and what we don't.
